'''Rafela Cindal''' (pronounced: rah-FELL-ah sin-DAHL) is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is tall and plump and of a dark complexion{{ref/book|7|34}}. She has a round face that is normally mild and pleasant, but could be serious or even stern. Her voice is normally sweet.

==Strength and Abilities==
Rafela is a [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of {{opsl|22}}. 

[[Merana Ambrey]] feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn]], even though she is its appointed leader. Rafela, [[Faeldrin Harella]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]] are the three strongest sisters in the group.{{ref/book|6|49}} She is strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]].

==History==
Rafela is 52 years old, she was born in [[948 NE]] and went to the Tower in {{ne|964}}. After six years as [[Novice]] and five as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the [[shawl]] in the year [[975 NE]]. 

When she was first raised Aes Sedai, Rafela attempted to revive many customs that had fallen into abeyance.

Because Rafela is one of the newest Blues, she is one of the sisters who present the shawl to [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] when they first become Aes Sedai, the other being [[Leane Sharif]]. She then escorts Siuan to the Blue Ajah living quarters. {{Ref/book|0|11}}

Rafela has a single [[Warder]], [[Mahiro Shukosa]], a [[Kandori]] Lord, who was particularly fond of [[Min]].

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]]. 
She is part of the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn|Salidar delegation]] sent to [[Caemlyn]] to meet with [[Rand al'Thor]]{{ref/book|6|p}}. Min thought that she was pleased that [[Rand]] has made Aes Sedai more acceptable in [[Tear]]{{ref/book|6|41}}, though Rafela also seemed worried that Rand might have murdered [[Morgase]].

She approaches [[Luan Norwelyn]] with certain promises{{ref/book|6|43}}.  

She accompanies [[Bera Harkin]] and [[Kiruna Nachiman]] to meet Rand in [[Cairhien]] after he flees [[Andor]]{{ref/book|6|49}}. 

She meets up with Perrin and the men from the [[Two Rivers]] before fighting in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. Afterwards, she is forced to swear fealty to Rand{{ref/book|6|55}}.

Rafela and [[Merana Ambrey]] negotiated the Bargain between Rand, as the [[Coramoor]], and [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]], as the Extraordinary Embassador from the Mistress of Ships of the [[Atha'an Miere]]{{ref/book|7|34}}. For some reason, the other Aes Sedai strongly approve of Rand's choice of Merana and Rafela. 

Rand was initially displeased with the two Aes Sedai over the final points of the Bargain, though was made to see that they actually did a good job under difficult circumstances{{ref/book|8|27}}.

After being sent by Rand to negiotiate with the rebel [[High Lords of Tear]]{{ref/book|9|25}}{{ref/book|9|32}}, she comes to an agreement with [[Estanda]]. The terms are that the rebels will disperse in return for [[Darlin Sisnera]] being made king{{ref/book|11|21}}.

Rafela is present in the Stone of Tear when Alanna disappears {{ref/book|13|12}}.

During the [[Last Battle]], Rafela fights with the [[Wise Ones]] and [[Sea Folk]] at [[Thakan'dar]] {{ref/book|14|30}}. It can be assumed she survives.

== Viewing ==
[[Min Farshaw]] sees her in the palm of Rand's hand. This indicates she will keep her oath and can be trusted by Rand{{ref/book|7|34}}.
